title: New Bernstein functions and subordination representations for time-nonlocal evolution equations
summary: This paper establishes subordination representations from multi-term time-fractional differential equations to single-term ones, a direction complementary to the previously known subordination from single-term to multi-term equations; combining the two complementary directions also yields subordination representations between two multi-term equations. The crucial step is to prove that certain implicitly defined functions are Bernstein functions.
